parameters.name: GroupByKey
parameters.description:
The dimension by which the resource count is grouped. Valid values:

- ResourceType: resource type.

- Region: region.

parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: This parameter is scheduled to be deprecated before 00:00:00 on June 30, 2021. The API for the account group feature that will replace this parameter will be available before 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. If you are using this parameter, we recommend that you switch to the API for the account group feature after 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. For more information about account groups, see [Account group](~~211534~~).
